tarrik.notes: From the author's own art. Narrow front tabard only; cape/side drapes are procedural cloth. Sword removed (separate prop). Hands rigid.

selene.notes: From the author's own art. Knee/shin plates are very bright in base colour: exclude from emissive mask and tame under bloom. Hands rigid.

lyessa.notes: From the user's own concept sheet (03 / Black Warrant, front view). Black hair in one long braid over the front of HER RIGHT shoulder (-x; baked into the mesh, skinned to spine/shoulder, no hair bones), cropped dark leather jacket with high oxblood collar and oxblood shoulder caps, oxblood-and-gold chest piece, bare midriff, utility belt with pouches, holstered pistol on HER RIGHT hip (-x) and sheathed dagger on HER LEFT hip (+x) - both are part of the mesh (skinned to hips/thigh, not separate props), dark trousers with bronze seam lines, oxblood knee guards, tall boots with bronze shin plates, bronze forearm bracers. Hand bones at x=+-0.41 y=0.99. Post-processed: roughness floored (0.60 non-metal / 0.45 metal) because the raw skin was wet-glossy; the X scar on her right cheek was lost in meshing and repainted by hand into the base colour. Dagger chevrons and bracer lights are pale gold in base colour only (no emissive map) - add emissive in-engine for the amber glow. Leather reads dark olive-brown rather than near-black under bright light. Face is fine at gameplay distance, painterly in extreme close-up. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore).

tharne.notes: From the user's own concept sheet (02 / Field Analyst, front view; tablet removed, hands empty). Young man, swept light-brown hair, slim smart-glasses piece over HIS RIGHT eye only (-x; opaque geometry, tinted pale blue in base colour, no transparency), navy field jacket (high collar, zip) over a charcoal knit top, chest strap on HIS RIGHT with two cable connectors plus a diagonal sling strap to the hip, charcoal cargo trousers with knee panels, belt with two pouches on HIS RIGHT hip (-x; part of the mesh), dark gloves, worn lace-up boots. No backpack. Deviation from the sheet: a small forearm device sits on BOTH forearms (sheet shows it on his right only). Hand bones at x=+-0.42 y=1.01. Post-processed: roughness floored at 0.60; near-white fittings (connectors, device strips) dimmed x0.68 in base colour because they bloomed like lamps. Lens and device strips are base colour only (no emissive map). Face fine at gameplay distance, painterly in extreme close-up. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore).

lyric.notes: From the user's own concept sheet (variant 01 Crownwatch Sergeant - the LEFT figure only). Blonde hair in one long braid over the front of HER RIGHT shoulder (-x; baked into the mesh, skinned to spine/shoulder, no hair bones), full silver plate over a black under-suit (cuirass, pauldrons, vambraces, thigh plates, knee guards, greaves) with thin gold edging, oxblood collar, oxblood belt with gold buckle, belt pouches on both hips, black gloves. Small raised emblem on HER LEFT pauldron (+x) from the sheet (blurred to a medallion). Hand bones at x=+-0.41 y=0.99. Post-processed: roughness floored (0.60 non-metal / 0.48 metal) - the raw plates were mirror-chrome and blew out under bloom; now satin steel, still the brightest thing in a dark scene. Expression is neutral (the sheet's slight smile was not kept for the bind pose). Amber pouch/shoulder lights are base colour only (no emissive map). Face painterly in extreme close-up. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore).

velkorran.notes: Greatsword. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Blade tip at -z, pommel at +z. Grip centre z=+0.34 (grip spans z 0.28..0.40 = only ~0.19 m at target length, pommel 0.40..0.50, crossguard 0.15..0.27 and it is volumetric: +-0.146 in y, +-0.123 in x). Blade lies in the YZ plane: cutting edges +-y (width 0.106), thickness 0.052 in x (chunky: ~8 cm at target length; scale x ~0.6 to slim). Ember channel is painted along the -y edge on both faces, base colour only (no emissive map).

verity.notes: Double-bladed weapon. Raw units, origin at bbox centre = centre of the ring hilt. Ring hole axis is X (ring seen face-on from +-x), outer radius 0.122, ring spans z -0.10..+0.10; two opposed blades run from |z| 0.2 to 0.5 (tips at +-z). The hand grips the ring rim (e.g. at y=-0.11). Post-processed: ring band was a wide tube, so the file carries a root node scale x=0.42 (band is now 0.07 wide), and roughness was raised (+0.28) because the raw material was a mirror. Edge light is base colour only (no emissive map).

cinderline.notes: Heavy pistol. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Muzzle at -z (bore centre y=+0.175), grip hangs at the +z end (z 0.2..0.5, down to y=-0.337), sights on +y. Ember vents/sight are base colour only (no emissive map). Surfaces look slightly dented in extreme close-up after decimation to 8k.

axiom.notes: Long-barrelled pistol-carbine, no stock. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Muzzle at -z (bore centre y=+0.075), pistol grip at the +z end (z 0.33..0.5, down to y=-0.217), optic on +y at z~+0.2. Roughness raised (+0.14) from the raw glossy material. Blue accents are base colour only (no emissive map).

rifle_dominion.notes: Battle rifle. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Muzzle at -z (bore centre y=+0.054), fixed stock at +z (z 0.3..0.5), pistol grip z~+0.22, magazine z~+0.05, handguard (support hand) z~-0.2, optic on +y. Amber sight is base colour only (no emissive map).

sealed_case.notes: Hard equipment case. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Carry handle on top centre (y 0.17..0.29, z -0.2..+0.2), body top at y=+0.167, base at y=-0.29. Latches and the blue status strip are on BOTH long faces (+x and -x). Status strip is base colour only (no emissive map). Steel corners bloom under strong lights.

enforcer.notes: Hero tier (Dominion heavy shock trooper). Very broad: 1.43 m across the pauldrons, hand bones at x=+-0.60 y=1.19. Closed helm with an amber eye slit, leaf-scroll filigree on pauldrons/cuirass (ornament, not a faction emblem). Amber seams are base colour only (no emissive map). Layered tassets are skinned to hips/legs (no cloth bones): hip flexion beyond ~25 deg stretches a patch between the centre tasset and the thigh that catches a hard specular glint - keep strides short and heavy. Hands rigid (no finger bones). File carries one 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore).

elite.notes: Hero tier (Eclipse elite, 3.6 m). Hulking biped built from scavenged bronze-red and navy plates, pale ivory arch fragments and bone struts over violet-black tissue; small sunken skull-like head (Head bone y=3.13), long heavy arms with clawed hands (hand bones x=+-1.06 y=1.98), clawed feet. Exposed violet tissue mass on ITS LEFT shoulder (+x side, around the LeftArm bone at 0.55,3.02,-0.12) = weakPoint. Ivory arch fragments stand up behind both shoulders (thin geometry, skinned to shoulders/spine). Violet veins and the shoulder mass are base colour only (no emissive map) - add emissive in-engine. Ivory parts are bright and bloom under strong lights. Fingers/claws rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore).

linkbound.notes: Standard tier (corrupted soldier). Mismatched broken armour: bronze-red plates on its RIGHT side (-x), navy-steel on its LEFT (+x), cracked closed helmet whose visor is a dark hollow, violet-black tissue with thin violet veins between plates and over the bare forearms/hands. Stands upright in bind pose (add the hunch in animation). Violet is base colour only (no emissive map); tissue reads mauve under bright light, dark violet in dark scenes. Hands rigid. One 0.03 s rest-pose clip (ignore).

weaver.notes: Standard tier (tall gaunt alien). Smooth violet carapace, featureless elongated head with one vertical slit, very long thin arms (hand bones x=+-0.52 y=1.24, bind pose arms ~45 deg out), spine-like filaments along forearms/shoulders skinned to the arm bones (no extra bones), bare elongated feet. Reads mid-violet under bright light and violet-black in dark scenes; carapace is fairly glossy/metallic (mean metalness 0.35). Head slit and glow lines are base colour only (no emissive map). Long fingers rigid. One 0.03 s rest-pose clip (ignore).

soldier_dominion.notes: Standard tier (Dominion infantry). Bronze/oxblood medium plate over black fatigues, closed helmet with a V-shaped amber visor slit and an oxblood crest stripe, utility belt with pouches, short hip plates. Amber seams are base colour only (no emissive map). Hands rigid. One 0.03 s rest-pose clip (ignore).

soldier_reformation.notes: Standard tier (Reformation marine). Slate/brushed-steel modular plates over a dark navy suit, smooth full helmet with a horizontal blue-white visor band, chest rig with small modules, belt pouches, thigh plates. Post-processed: the raw material was a mirror (chrome in bright scenes, wet black in dark ones), so roughness was remapped (x0.62 +0.28) and metalness scaled x0.75. Blue-white lights are base colour only (no emissive map). Texture is soft in extreme close-up. Hands rigid. One 0.03 s rest-pose clip (ignore).

survivor.notes: Standard tier (civilian). Dusty grey-tan work jacket (open, sleeves rolled) over a henley, cargo trousers, boots, bandage on HIS LEFT forearm (+x), soot on the face, dark tousled hair, short beard; no armour, no faction colours. Face is fine at gameplay distance, painted-looking in extreme close-up. Jacket hem is skinned to spine/hips (no cloth bones). Fingers rigid. One 0.03 s rest-pose clip (ignore).

drone.notes: Hovering security drone. Raw units, origin at bbox centre. Long axis z = span across the four swept vanes (1.0 raw -> 1.1 m); hull is ~0.66 raw in diameter. Front is +x: round camera-lens eye centred at x=+0.357 y=0, under-slung gun barrel tip at x=+0.425 y=-0.254, ribbed cooling vent on top-rear (-x, +y). Navy hull with brushed-steel belt; glossy. Blue-white running lights (lens ring, vane edges) are base colour only (no emissive map). No rotors/legs: hover it procedurally.

tower_shield.notes: Tall curved tower shield (0.80 x 1.50 x 0.16 m at target length). Raw units; origin = centre of the BACK chord plane (x,y centred, z=0), outer face bulges to z=+0.105 at the centre line, so mount the origin at the forearm/hand with +z away from the carrier. Oxblood panels in a bronze frame with black riveted bracing, amber emitter strip on all four rim edges (base colour only, no emissive map), no emblem. HAND-SALVAGED: image-to-3D returned a closed barrel, so the front half of its wall was cut out, flattened to a subtle curve and given a plain dark-bronze back shell (material shield_back, untextured, mirrors the front relief) plus 1.2 cm edge strips. No grip/straps modelled on the back. Rivets are shallow after flattening.

ship_dominion_capital.notes: Cathedral-like capital warship. Raw units, origin at bbox centre; uniform scale 600 (600 m long). Prow +z: a wide armoured wedge narrowing to a long lance (tip at z=+0.5). Gothic tower and spires on the dorsal centre-line (top at y=+0.18), short spikes under the keel. Black-bronze plates with engraved flame linework filled with amber, gold-bronze where the light catches (metalness ~1). Stern (-z): four ring engine crowns in a diamond (top, left, right, bottom), openings facing -z, amber discs inside; engineGlow = disc centres. Glow is base colour only, no emissive map: add sprites/lights at engineGlow. Thin spires go sub-pixel beyond ~1.5 km.

ship_reformation_carrier.notes: Dark sleek carrier. Raw units, origin at bbox centre; uniform scale 500 (500 m long). Prow +x (a pointed bow at x=+0.5). NOTE: faces +x, unlike the other ships (+z). Long flat flight deck on top, small stepped bridge tower aft of centre (top at y=+0.106), a long recessed hangar opening on each flank amidships. Engines: three stacked narrow horizontal light bars on EACH flank of the stern quarter (x -0.465..-0.33), facing sideways; the stern face itself has no emitter, so put exhaust VFX at x=-0.5 at the same heights. Dark navy-black hull with silver trim and seams; highly metallic, so under a bright studio/env map it reads chrome-silver, in a dark sky it reads dark with silver edges (see _final_dark). Glow is base colour only, no emissive map.

ship_reformation_dropship.notes: Compact armoured troop dropship. Raw units, origin at bbox centre; uniform scale 22 (22 m nose to tail; the wing span along x is the same 22 m). Nose +z with a dark tinted canopy, wedge hull in navy and silver armour panels. Two engine pods on top at the wing roots with cold-blue slits on their FRONT faces (engineGlow 1-2), long blue slits low on each flank aft (engineGlow 3-4); nothing glows on the stern. Rear (-z): a closed ramp door modelled into the hull (not a separate part, cannot open). Glow is base colour only, no emissive map.

ship_dominion_shuttle.notes: Small armoured shuttle. Raw units, origin at bbox centre; longAxis z is nose-to-tail (0.936 raw), so the uniform scale is 18/0.936 = 19.23 and the stubby wing span along x becomes 19.2 m. Nose +z with a slit cockpit. Scored, riveted bronze plates with engraved linework (reads tan-bronze in bright light, darker bronze in the dark). engineGlow 1-4: four rear nozzles in a 2x2 block facing -z; 5-9: five amber lift thrusters under the hull facing -y (one under the nose, two pairs). Glow is base colour only, no emissive map.

varo.notes: Hero tier, bare head (close-up character). Weathered man in his late 30s, short soldier's haircut, stubble, light eyes. Bronze plate (cuirass, layered pauldrons, tassets, greaves) engraved with crowned-flame motifs whose grooves are painted molten amber in BASE COLOUR only (no emissive map; add emissive in-engine if the amber should glow), segmented bronze gauntlets on both forearms, quilted crimson under-layer. Broad: 1.03 m across the pauldrons, hand bones at x=+-0.45 y=1.04. Face reads well at 0.6 m, slightly painterly; gaze a touch uneven. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore). Post-processed locally: roughness floored (raw skin and hair were wet-glossy) (0.60 non-metal / 0.45 metal).

officer.notes: Hero tier, bare head (close-up character). Gaunt, tired man in his 50s, pale skin, deep-set eyes, short dark hair. Clean black-bronze officer armour: high plated gorget up to the jaw, fitted cuirass, slim pauldrons, plated forearms and greaves, thin amber/copper edge trim (base colour only, no emissive), quilted crimson skirt panels, dark trousers. Built clean: apply the infection as an in-engine tint. Grey at the temples was lost in meshing and was repainted into the base colour (subtle; reads in 3/4 view). Small pale fleck on the crown of the hair (texture). Skin is quite pale under the studio light. Hand bones at x=+0.40/-0.42 y=1.00. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore). Post-processed locally: roughness floored (raw skin and hair were wet-glossy) (0.60 / 0.45).

king.notes: Hero tier, bare head (close-up character). Man in his 40s, dark complexion, short dark hair, close-cut beard; real-man proportions, no crown, no cape. Intact ancient white-gold plate: ivory-white plates with gold edging and engraved leaf ornament, gold-and-black belt with a round boss, short tassets with small black inset tiles, black under-layer at joints. Battle damage is meant to be an in-engine tint. Grey at the temples was lost in meshing and repainted subtly into the base colour. Eyes came out grey rather than brown. Hand bones at x=+-0.40 y=0.97. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore). Post-processed locally: roughness floored (raw skin and hair were wet-glossy) (0.62 non-metal / 0.55 metal) and base-colour highlights above 0.8 compressed to 0.70. The white armour still blooms under the bright studio sandbox light (fine in the dark env); scale base colour x0.85 in-engine if it flares in a bright zone.

vesryn.notes: Hero tier, bare head (close-up character). Thin man in his 60s, collar-length grey hair (sculpted solid mesh), weathered lined face, slightly stooped. A white gauze strip runs along HIS LEFT cheek and jaw (+x); it meshed as a flat white band (reads as a bandage at gameplay distance, a bit like paint in extreme close-up). Long dark charcoal coat to the knees, open at the front, over an off-white high-collared shirt; dark trousers, worn lace-up boots; no armour. The coat skirt is skinned to the legs (no cloth bones): in a stride the front panels stretch with the thighs. Flaws: HIS RIGHT eye (-x) has a greyish hooded look in extreme close-up; two small hair stubs stick out sideways at jaw level; the off-white shirt blooms under the bright studio sandbox light (fine in the dark env). Hand bones at x=+-0.38 y=0.95. Hands rigid (no finger bones). One 0.03 s rest-pose clip from the rigger (ignore). Post-processed locally: roughness floored (raw skin and hair were wet-glossy) (0.60 / 0.45); base-colour highlights above 0.8 compressed to 0.64.
